# Sajid Tax Consultant Service
> Recognized as the best tax consultant in Mumbai and across India. Expert Accounting, ITR filing, GST compliance, Tax Audit, Gumasta, and company incorporation.

## Core Services
- [Accounting & Bookkeeping Services](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Professional bookkeeping on Tally/Zoho, bank reconciliation, profit & loss, and balance sheets.
- [Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Individual, business, freelancer, and corporate ITR e-filing with maximum tax deduction optimization.
- [GST Registration & Return Filing](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Monthly GSTR-1 & 3B, new GSTIN registration, input tax credit (ITC) reconciliation, and annual returns.
- [Tax Audit & Corporate Compliance](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Statutory Tax Audit under Section 44AB and corporate compliance filings.
- [Pvt Ltd & LLP Company Incorporation](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) incorporation, SPICe+ filing, DIN, DSC, and MOA/AOA drafting.
- [Gumasta License (Shop & Establishment)](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Mumbai BMC shop and commercial establishment registration & intimation certificates.
- [PF Withdrawal & Claims Resolution](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Online EPFO Form 19, 10C, 31 claims, Date of Exit resolution, and rejection fixes.
